verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a local media-processing CLI and library that operates on whatever files, pipes, or streams the user supplies. It has no hosted service, accounts, or production data store, so a separate sandbox-versus-production environment is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg shipping any environment-isolation or test-mode capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
